funded_consistency_effect: payout needs total profit >= largest EOD day / share (payout 1: 20%, 2: 25%, 3+: 30%)
after_payout: next payout needs a new profit goal ($2,000); may be moved to live at Tradeify's discretion
automation_conditions: bots allowed if: you prove sole ownership; no similar orders on other accounts; live video of you enabling the code on your own PC on request; not used at other firms; not HFT
python_order_route: No firm API. Tradeify brokers: Tradovate (NinjaTrader, TradingView) or Rithmic (Tradesea, Quantower, Sierra Chart, R|Trader) or WealthCharts
vps_allowed: login must not be via VPN/VPS; after normal login VPS may be used 'at your own risk'
